520661.name: Crystal Missile
520661.description:
Launches small crystals at a single Nikke, dealing damage.
Crystals can be intercepted.

520662.name: Replica Glass Slippers Normal Attack
520662.description:
Summons Replica Glass Slippers and fires lasers at the Nikke with the highest ATK.
Replica Glass Slippers can be destroyed with just one attack.

520668.name: Rapid-Fire Rifle
520668.description: Fires a barrage of machine gun bullets at the Nikke with the highest ATK.

520669.name: Replica Glass Slippers Full Attack
520669.description:
Summons all Replica Glass Slippers, dealing damage to all Nikkes.
Mirror Container generates a code barrier to defend against attacks while using Replica Glass Slippers Full Attack. While the barrier is up, only Electric Code Nikkes can deal damage.

520670.name: Harmony Cube Overload
520670.description: Emits a shock wave forward from the Harmony Cube. This attack must be interrupted via Special Interruption; otherwise, it deals damage to all Nikkes.

520672.name: Glass Slippers Attack Mode
520672.description:
Summons Glass Slippers to attack a single Nikke, dealing damage.
Glass Slippers can be destroyed with just one attack.

520676.name: Glass Slippers Destroy Mode
520676.description:
Summons all Glass Slippers, dealing damage to all Nikkes.
Mirror Container generates a code barrier to defend against attacks while using Glass Slippers Destroy Mode. While the barrier is up, only Electric Code Nikkes can deal damage.

520677.name: Harmony Cube Laser
520677.description: Fires a barrage of lasers at the Nikke with the highest ATK from the Harmony Cube.

520678.name: Crystal Arrow
520678.description:
Launches Crystal Needles at multiple Nikkes, dealing damage.
Crystal Needles can be intercepted.

520680.name: Glass Slippers Defense Mode
520680.description:
Summons Glass Slippers and drastically increases Mirror Container's defense.
While Glass Slippers are in attack mode, they can be destroyed with just one attack.
Destroying them can decrease Mirror Container's defense.
